mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% (using 20-day rolling window of FEDFUNDS).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 9.5% indicates severe labor market distress, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 2% from their prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% from the prior month signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increase above 2.5% signals inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS and HOUST decline by more than 1% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (quarterly).

mechanism_narrative: Low annualized inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change < 1.5%) maintains accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change is below 1.5%.
